messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up — on athena-v1.2 int8 bring-up I’m seeing token splits around kanbun/rubric markers in JP/zh samples. Put a tiny repro below, looks like the detokenizer is inserting extra spaces and dropping the kanbun marker.
hiro: Oof, can you paste the exact input + token sequence? small example is enough.
sophie: sure — repro input (short):
```
吾輩は猫である《訓:わがはい》。
漢文例：天地玄黄、宇宙洪荒。※訓点：︐︑
```
Observed output from athena-v1.2:int8 (staging):
```
吾輩 は 猫 で ある 《 訓 : わがはい 》 。
天地 玄 黄 、 宇宙 洪 荒 。 ※ 訓 点 ： ︐ ︑
```
Notice the extra spaces inside the angle brackets and between kanji clusters. detok on float32 baseline doesn’t do this.
liam: Thanks. Can you dump the token IDs and the tokenizer version? suspect tokenizer merge table + quant kernel interaction (cache/vocab alignment) or an off-by-one when converting byte pairs in q8 mapping.
sophie: token ids snippet: `[1342, 4521, 78, 200, 9999, 43021, 43022, 120, 77]` — tokenizer v0.9.3 (used in onboarding script). Float32 run uses v0.9.3 too.
maria: @sophie did you run the detok pipeline with locale-aware normalization? i.e. NFC vs NFKC might affect ruby markers. also check grapheme cluster boundaries with UAX#29 tests.
sophie: ran NFC. grapheme tests show mismatch for sequences containing U+300A/U+300B (《》) + ASCII colon. Only happens with int8 binary on athena runtime.
nina: I'll try to reproduce on a local q8 build — can you link the model artifact and the exact convert/quant command you used? also which kernel backend (xnnpack vs custom asm) was selected?
sophie: model: s3://redwood-athena/athena-v1.2/athena-v1.2-int8.tar.gz
quant cmd: `python quantize.py --mode int8 --calib 5k --backend auto`
kernel backend chosen: fast-attn-qint8 (logs attached in staging deploy)
liam: if the backend is auto it might pick the new lowered kernel that uses a different byte-to-subtoken mapping for multibyte sequences — I’ve seen it insert soft spaces around non-ascii clusters in prior q kernels.
maria: also check postprocess step that strips ZWJ/ZWSP — maybe quant path introduced an extra normalization pass. any mlang detok unit tests failing?
sophie: unit tests: mlang-detok::ja_basic passed, but ja_ruby_suite failed 3/24 cases (spacing inside ruby brackets). float32 artifact passes all.
eval-bot: athena-v1.2-int8 staging eval summary: detok-spacing-drop: -0.18 (lower is worse), bleu on kanbun set: -1.9, chrF: -0.7. Full report: https://internal.redwood/evals/2967890123
hiro: Good catch, @nina can you run bisect between kernels? try forcing kernel=legacy-q8 and compare tokens.
nina: Running now, will post micro-bisect results. ETA ~30m.
liam: Also try quantizing with --preserve-tokenmap (temp flag) to skip remapping step — see if that is the culprit.
sophie: tried preserve-tokenmap — spacing issue disappears but some perf regressed. so token remap step seems involved.
maria: Interesting — could be token id remapping interacting with tokenizer metadata (span offsets). If remap doesn't update tokenizer offsets used by detok, you'll see these splits.
hiro: Action items: 1) @nina run kernel bisect (legacy vs fast-attn-qint8). 2) @liam test quantize with and without tokenmap and capture token id diffs. 3) @sophie collect minimal failing testcases (single-line). 4) @maria add a detok unit test for kanbun/ruby markers.
sophie: added minimal tests to the repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/kanbun-repro-2967890123 (includes inputs, token ids, detok outputs)
nina: kernel bisect done — fast-attn-qint8 reproduces the split; legacy-q8 does not. attaching short log: `kernel: fast-attn-qint8 -> token_map_adjust() inserts 0x20 at subj boundary for CJK clusters`.
liam: ok that’s actionable. I'll open a PR to remove the spurious insertion in token_map_adjust for unicode category Lo clusters and add the kanbun unit tests.
maria: also add a quick eval on ar/rtl to make sure we didn't accidentally touch bidi behavior while fixing — last time a tokenmap tweak moved Arabic opening quotes.
sophie: good call. I noticed one Arabic sample where opening quote was on wrong side in int8 outputs earlier — will include in test bundle.
hiro: Thanks all — ping when PR is up and staging re-run finishes. :thumbsup:
sophie: thanks! will follow up after liam's PR and nina's kernel patch land.
